reports.title: PDF Solutions® Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Financial Outlook
section: “In the third quarter of 2026, PDF Solutions continued its growth trajectory with total revenues 20% higher compared to the third quarter of 2025,” said John Kibarian, CEO and President of the Company. He continued, “On September 9, 2026, we announced Exensio Aurora, the new, highly-scalable Exensio analytics architecture. Exensio Aurora is purpose-built to handle semiconductor manufacturing data at petabyte scale and to securely deploy agentic AI across manufacturing operations and the supply chain. We believe this new architecture will help semiconductor companies address the challenges associated with the fast growth and transformation of the industry. Based on actual results through the third quarter and the pipeline for the fourth quarter, we reaffirm our 20% annual revenue growth target for 2026.”
